description: This file contains a culture information definition for Arabic (Algeria) for a date handling library (likely datejs). It defines locale-specific names, formats, regex patterns, and prototype extensions to handle date parsing and formatting specific to the 'ar-DZ' culture.

methods.name: clearTime
